questions.explanation: `git diff` shows unstaged changes; `git diff --staged` shows what is staged.

questions.prompt: Which command compares the working tree plus the staging area against the last commit?
questions.explanation: `git diff HEAD` compares working tree + staging area with the last commit; `--stat` only summarizes changed files.

questions.prompt: Which command shows which commit last changed each line of a file?
questions.explanation: `git blame <file>` annotates each line with the commit that last changed it.
